decisions.statement: The default belongs to the command's entry rather than to the argument's page.
One command may default an argument that another command leaves out.
An entry stating one takes it over the default the argument's own page states.
The value is written as a call would say it, and read as a said value is read.
An argument carrying no value states none here.
An entry stating one is always answered, as one a command needs is.
Being always answered, it is never typed undefined for a pair a group forbids.

definition: what an argument carries under one command where no call says it
